clips.title: The story
paras: Stormwind guards watch the eastern frontier from Ridgepoint Tower. They keep vigil over the perilous corridors, valleys, and roads leading into neighboring wilderness.

At Ridgepoint Tower, the garrison watches the valleys and roads of eastern Elwynn. The tower stands on high ground, where Stormwind's authority reaches its eastern border and the wilds begin. Its guards keep watch over the routes before threats can reach the farms and settlements nearer Northshire and Goldshire.

Ridgepoint Tower faces threats from several directions. East lie the Redridge Mountains, where aggressive gnoll packs and blackrock orc raiders test human defenses. Across the southern river, undead horrors prowl the timberline of Duskwood. Rogue Defias Brotherhood bandits also haunt nearby wilderness camps, looking for gaps in the guard's defenses.
